prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Green Party Manifesto 2024 – Summary (≤500 words)

Vision: A fairer, greener UK where climate action tackles the cost-of-living crisis. Greens propose major public investment, fair taxation of wealth and pollution, and putting essential services back in public hands.

Health and care
- NHS: Rapid GP access, universal NHS dentistry, pay restoration for staff, reduce waits; approx. £8bn extra in year one rising to £28bn by 2030, plus £20bn capital. Boost primary care, diagnostics, public health and a National Cancer Plan. Mental health parity with access to therapies within 28 days; counsellors in every school. Support assisted dying; end new HIV cases by 2030.
- Social care: Free personal care; £20bn/yr; fair pay and career paths; end exploitation of overseas carers; “Gloria’s Law” for essential care supporters. Children’s social care +£3bn. Disability benefits +5%; oppose punitive assessments and PIP vouchers.

Homes and planning
- 150,000 new social homes/yr; end Right to Buy; rent controls; end Section 21. Passivhaus-level new builds; protect Green Belt; small, well-serviced developments.
- Retrofit: £29bn for home insulation (five years), £9bn for low-carbon heating, £7bn for heat adaptation, £4bn for public buildings; area-based council-led delivery.

Energy and climate
- No new oil/gas; end subsidies; carbon tax starting £120/t rising to £500/t within a decade; phase out nuclear.
- Targets: ~70% electricity from wind by 2030; 80GW offshore, 53GW onshore, 100GW solar by 2035; end onshore wind ban; expand grid, storage, interconnectors; community energy, public ownership of Crown Estate’s energy assets; regulate biomass.

Economy, taxes and ownership
- Invest average £40bn/yr in a green transformation (renewables, rail, retrofit, active travel, industry, water). Bring rail, water and the Big 5 retail energy firms into public ownership.
- Fair taxes: Wealth tax (1% >£10m, 2% >£1bn); align CGT and investment income rates with earnings; remove NI upper limit; fairer inheritance and pension tax relief; path to Land Value Tax; tougher business windfall taxes; clamp down on avoidance. Borrow to invest; carbon tax to raise up to £80bn by end of parliament, then fall as emissions drop.

Work and welfare
- Minimum wage £15/hr for all; day-one rights; repeal anti-union laws; 10:1 pay ratio; move toward four-day week.
- Welfare: +£40/week to UC and legacy benefits; end five-week wait and two-child cap; scrap sanctions and bedroom tax; uprate pensions; increase Carer’s Allowance; UBI as long-term goal.

Nature, animals, food
- Rights of Nature Act; 30% of land/sea for nature by 2030; public water; Clean Air Act; Right to Roam; re-wet peat; strong marine protections. Ban blood sports, badger cull, factory farming practices; create Animal Protection Commission.
- Food: Triple farm support for nature-friendly farming; cut pesticides; grow more fruit/veg; free school meals for all and breakfast clubs to Year 6.

Education
- End tuition fees; restore grants. Schools: +£8bn (incl. £2bn for teacher pay), £2.5bn/yr to fix buildings; end high-stakes testing and Ofsted; SEND +£5bn; nurses/counsellors in schools; Sure Start +£1.4bn; 35 hours funded childcare from 9 months; FE/sixth-form uplift; restore EMA.

Transport
- Public rail; local control of buses; £10bn/yr subsidy by end of parliament; £19bn extra over five years; £2.5bn/yr for active travel; oppose new roads; fuel duty escalator and road pricing; end new ICE sales by 2027, road use by 2035; EV scrappage; frequent flyer levy; ban short domestic flights where rail <3 hours.

Democracy, rights, migration, culture, justice
- Proportional representation; replace House of Lords; votes at 16; repeal Elections Act; defend HRA/ECHR; trans self-ID; devolution and +£5bn/yr to local government.
- Migration: End hostile environment, NRPF and 10-year route; safe routes; allow asylum seekers to work; new Department of Migration; scrap spousal income rules.
- Culture/media/digital: £5bn for community arts/sport; cap media ownership at 20%; implement Leveson; Digital Bill of Rights; precautionary AI regulation.
- Policing/justice: Rebuild trust; end routine stop-and-search/facial recognition; prioritise VAWG; decriminalise drug possession with health-led diversion; major investment to clear court backlogs.

Foreign policy
- Support Ukraine; work to rejoin EU (Customs Union first, restore free movement, Erasmus). Israel/Palestine: immediate ceasefire, recognise Palestine, end UK arms exports to Israel, prosecute war crimes. Aid to 1% GNI by 2033; climate finance to 1.5% incl. Loss and Damage. Sign TPNW, cancel Trident, pursue NATO reforms incl. No First Use.
